name: session-debug
description: Debug a specific session by inspecting its full event chain (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop, SubagentStop, Compaction, APIError, TurnDuration, Notification events), agent hierarchy (recursive parent/child tree with subagent_type and depth), token usage with compaction baselines, workflow intelligence data (orchestration DAG, error propagation by depth), and session metadata (thinking_blocks, turn_count, total_turn_duration_ms).
